75561.label: ZZjj -> 4l EW (no top)
75561.r1: Decay inside the MadGraph matrix element (process card decay chain `v > l v`); no separate decay step, no filter (fragment filterEfficiency 1.0), no matching (ickkw 0): R1 applies, the portal total_value is the complete generator cross section of the sample.

theory_options.option: none found for the generator phase space
theory_options.note: CMS measured EW VBS in fiducial regions with reconstruction-like cuts (e.g. EW ZZjj 0.33 fb, SM 0.275 fb, arXiv:2008.07013 abstract; EW W+W-jj 10.2 fb, SM 9.1 fb, arXiv:2205.05711 abstract). These are NOT the generator phase space of the samples (m_jj > 100 GeV, |eta_l| < 3 at generator level), so they cannot be used directly; no NLO calculation for the generator phase space was found.

75561.v5_analogue: Dibosons (E1): generator x NNLO/NLO k-factor (WZ, ZZ) or NNLO total x BR (WW); tribosons 72701/72711 and ttZ/ttW: generator NLO value as is. No EW VV+2j precedent: E2 dropped the EW V+2j samples (35999/35987/35993) before any value was chosen.
75561.notes: CMS card (gridpack): p p > z z j j $ t t~ QED=4 QCD=0, z > l+ l- (l = e mu tau), on-shell Z decay chain (bwcutoff 15); m_jj > 100, |eta_l| < 3, |eta_j| < 5, pT_j > 10 GeV. ATLAS Sherpa: off-shell 4 charged leptons + 2 jets, m_ll > 0.25/0.46/3.8 GeV (ee/mumu/tautau), pT_l > 5, 2 jets pT > 15, NO m_jj cut, 0,1j@LO merged; incl. gamma* and triboson-like diagrams. McM 7.1654e-4 pb differs from the portal 9.928e-4 pb (factor 1.39; unexplained).

37276.label: ggF H -> ee gamma (Dalitz, no m_ll cut)
37276.r1: Decay H -> l+ l- gamma done by MadSpin inside the gridpack (madspin_card `decay x0 > l+ l- a`, spinmode none). The decay IS inside the portal value: ee and mumu samples of the same production differ (e.g. ggF 2.816e-3 vs 1.858e-3 pb), which only the decay can cause. Not a separate Pythia/JHUGen step, so R1's 'decay not inside' does NOT apply. Whether the listed matching efficiency (FxFx) is inside is the general R1 assumption (UNVERIFIED for these records).

theory_options.option: YR4 sigma x B(ATLAS Pythia8, m_ll < 30 GeV)
theory_options.source: ATLAS arXiv:2103.10322 Sect. 3: B(H->eegamma) = 7.20e-5 estimated with Pythia 8 for m_ll < 30 GeV (an ATLAS MC estimate, not a theory calculation; agrees with Refs. [74,76] within 3 % 'when extrapolated to a common phase space')

theory_options.option: YR4 sigma x B(CMS MCFM)
theory_options.note: CMS-HIG-17-007 gives no ee value (only mumu)

theory_options.option: Z-pole part, if the sample contains it (see REPORT section 2)
theory_options.note: YR4 BR(H->Zgamma) x PDG BR(Z->ll) per flavour: the H->Zgamma part with m_ll near m_Z

theory_options.option: no published value for the full m_ll range of the sample (no m_ll cut)
implied B = portal / YR4 sigma (arithmetic only)
theory_options.note: the generator's own production sigma is not YR4, so this is not a measured BR

37276.v5_analogue: Every Higgs sample in v5 = YR4 production (mH = 125.00) x YR4 BR (x PDG Z BR), e.g. 37604 ggF H->Zgamma 48.58 x 0.001533 x 0.10099; VERIFIED BY MATAN 3 Nov. No YR4 BR exists for H -> l l gamma (Dalitz).

74670.label: ZH H -> mumu gamma (Dalitz, no m_ll cut)
74670.r1: Decay H -> l+ l- gamma done by MadSpin inside the gridpack (madspin_card `decay x0 > l+ l- a`, spinmode none). The decay IS inside the portal value: ee and mumu samples of the same production differ (e.g. ggF 2.816e-3 vs 1.858e-3 pb), which only the decay can cause. Not a separate Pythia/JHUGen step, so R1's 'decay not inside' does NOT apply. Whether the listed matching efficiency (FxFx) is inside is the general R1 assumption (UNVERIFIED for these records).

74314.label: qq -> ZH, H -> ZZ (JHUGen, 4-lepton filter)
74314.r1: Production POWHEG HZJ MiNLO (Z -> all, vdecaymode 10, min_z_mass 10 GeV); H decay in a SEPARATE JHUGen step (DecayMode1=8 Z->2l incl. tau, DecayMode2=9 Z->anything, FilterNLept=4, WriteFailedEvents=2). R1: the decay BR is NOT inside the portal value; the portal value 0.7935 pb is close to the ZH production sigma (YR4 qq->ZH 0.7612, ZH total 0.8839), so the 4-lepton filter efficiency is NOT inside it either (if it were, the production sigma would be ~4-5 pb). The portal 'matching_efficiency' 0.2 (McM match_efficiency 0.1509, the validation efficiency) is therefore most likely the JHUGen filter efficiency, not a jet-matching efficiency (INTERPRETATION, open).
